mr_title: fix: only watch needed env files

expected_issues.title: Env file paths compared with the file basename
expected_issues.description:
getEnvFilesForMode() now returns absolute paths (joined with envDir) but is compared with fileName, the basename of the changed file, so .env changes never match and the dev server no longer restarts when an env file is edited.

The PR changed getEnvFilesForMode(mode, envDir) to map every candidate through path.join(envDir, file). handleHMRUpdate still checks `.includes(fileName)` where fileName = path.basename(file). The comparison must use the absolute `file` path.

expected_issues.title: No test that editing an env file still restarts the server
expected_issues.description: The change alters both the watched paths and the env-file detection in handleHMRUpdate, but adds no test; a test editing .env in the dev server would have shown that the comparison with the basename never matches.
